content.short: Boiler Blockchain provides blockchain education and resources for Purdue University students.
content.description: Boiler Blockchain is a Purdue University-based organization focused on blockchain education and hands-on projects. It educates students about blockchain technology and supports them in building blockchain-based applications, giving practical experience across the full development cycle. The group also provides networking opportunities with active Web3 communities and offers chances to develop innovative blockchain solutions through real-world, hands-on initiatives.
content.meta: Boiler Blockchain educates Purdue students about blockchain and helps them build apps. Discover Boiler Blockchain and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
